parameters.name: Language
parameters.description:
The language in which you want to return the description of the role. Valid values:

*   en: English
*   zh-CN: Chinese
*   ja: Japanese

parameters.name: RoleName
parameters.description:
The name of the role.

The name must be 1 to 64 characters in length, and can contain letters, digits, periods (.), and hyphens (-).

example.unifiedCli: aliyun resourcemanager get-role --role-name ECSAdmin --biz-language zh-CN --api-version 2020-03-31 --region cn-hangzhou
